caption: Each cell is the global index i of one thread. Block 0 supplies i = 0 to 3 and Block 1 supplies i = 4 to 7; the pointer marks the thread with i = 5, which is threadIdx.x = 1 in blockIdx.x = 1.

spec.title: Thread index to array element
spec.aria: Two rows of four cells show global thread indices 0 to 3 in Block 0 and 4 to 7 in Block 1, with a pointer to index 5.
